- **The Git calls that initialize the override repository start no automatic maintenance or gc (bob#248).** Before this change, the override repository's `git commit` started Git's automatic maintenance (`git maintenance run --auto`), which can detach and keep working inside the repository after the commit has returned, so a caller that removed the agent directory right after `hire` raced it. Under Bun, `rmSync` then sometimes returned without an error and left the directory behind; with CI's Git (2.55.0), this reproduced locally the `bob-opcred-*` directory that the suite's leak check (#221) found intermittently. The Git calls that initialize the repository (run only when it has no `.git` yet) now pass `maintenance.auto=false` and `gc.auto=0`, so they start no automatic maintenance or gc. `operator-credential-env.test.ts` now disposes each session before returning, as pi's interactive mode does when it quits, and fails, naming the directory, if its cleanup leaves it. (`test/shell/override-repo-248.test.ts`, `test/shell/operator-credential-env.test.ts`)
